scenarios.name: Add and apply a second model-state parameter

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates an undimensioned rectangular sketch and extrudes it 1 in with zero taper
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State and activates Copy State
the user creates a fourth model state named Model State1 and reactivates Copy State
the user opens the model-state table and adds parameter d0
The MCAD Software has a model-state table containing length parameter d0
the extrusion has angular parameter d1 at 0 degrees
Copy State is active among four model states
the user adds d1 to the chosen parameters
the table shows both d0 and d1 columns
each d1 member cell shows 0 degrees
the user changes the Copy State d1 cell to "5 deg"
the chosen parameters include d0 and d1
Copy State shows d1 as 5 degrees
the other three members show d1 as 0 degrees
the parameter tree shows d1 at 5 degrees
